blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — JM Ronquillo rallied ClearSkiiin back from two sets down beat VNS Laticrete, 31-33, 21-25, 25-18, 25-20, 15-9, and stay unbeaten in three games in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Saturday at Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Ronquillo fired 24 points in the UV Smashers’ comeback win, where they routed the Griffins in the fifth set to take the early solo lead in the league’s 10th season. The expansion Spikers’ Turf squad also drew solid contribution from Nas Gwaza, who had 18 points off 14 kills, three blocks, and an ace. Louis Gamban was also […]...
